reviewContext.userProblem: The owner asked (translated): 'Self-review the UI and the features. Are we providing the same usability and functionality as Sentry? If not, improve it.' The committed self-review found 7 defects (B1-B7) and a 60-item Sentry gap table; the adopted scope is S0-S10.
requiredOutcomes: Wave 2: p08 (S6 alert rules, evaluator, action interval, mute, history, RunStarter, enriched workflows list), p11 (ActorDirectory, member edit/deactivate, self tokens, ownership rules, suggested assignees), p15 (alerts list/editor/history and profile UI) and p16 (dashboard, onboarding, integrations, tokens, ownership rules, member edit, workflows list UI).

Wave 3: p06 (S3 bulk, merge, unmerge, safety rule 5, plus INT-W2-04, INT-W2-05 and archive until_escalating parsing regressions on server, client, mock and IssueList), p07 (B1, B4, B6, B7, S5 detail backend), p10 (S8 dashboard, IssueReportSource, integrations status and tests) and p14 (B1, B4, B6, B7 detail UI).
Every new route declares exactly one permission; new routers are unregistered until p12 and compose by copying APIRoute objects.

Raw sample values never reach rows, logs, responses or payloads on the new surfaces (alert rules, fires and payloads, ownership rules and test locators, member edits, tokens, comments, mentions, activity, external issue bodies, dashboard, integration status, bulk and merge audit).

nonGoals: Deferred by the accepted review: releases, environments, projects, Discover, Jira create, replay/performance/profiling.
No redispatch or re-implementation of p01-p05, p09, p13; no dispatch of p12 or p17; no archiving.
No dependency change, no Alembic revision, no edit of existing migrations, no change to tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH or ty strictness, no per-file-ignore entries.
No router registration or wiring (v13-p12, run 3); no full v13 leak matrix, E2E flows, strict screenshots or live checks (v13-p17, run 3).
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards; plan files under 400 lines; every Python file under 1000 lines.
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no type-ignore or ty-ignore; no Any, object, dict/mapping types or **kwargs; dataclasses and enums only.
Masking contract: raw detected values are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; user text passes Redactor; errors never echo input.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests skip without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL; live tests skip offline.

Conventions 2 and 7a: write only inside writePaths; per-edit fresh read and pre/post SHA-256 in the Progress Log; a needed change elsewhere is a Reconciliation request; fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands.
No git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add by workers; bun install only with --frozen-lockfile; builds and logs go to /tmp.
intentionalTradeoffs: Scoped ruff/ty commands cover only each plan's own paths, so a sibling's in-progress file cannot fail them; typelint runs on the whole repository and is filtered to the plan's paths.
The full pytest run is informational during fanout and is rerun at integration; a failure caused only by a sibling's in-progress file is recorded as such.
p06 is named a backend plan but also owns the UI side of the bulk contract in wave 3, so the carry-over items close end to end in one plan without a same-wave collision.

Only one plan per wave runs bun run screenshots (p16 in wave 2, p14 in wave 3) because port 4319 and /tmp/telescreen-v13-p03-screenshots are shared; the integration review reruns screenshots on the combined tree; p17 runs them strict in run 3. A missing browser is a recorded verification gap, never a pass.
Run-2 plans assert masking on their own surfaces in their own test directories; tests/leak/** stays read-only until p17.
designDecisionsAndRationale: R2-D1: bulk body accepts start/end with the same parse_period rules as GET /api/issues; the UI sends them for a custom period (INT-W2-04).
R2-D2: bulk params keys follow the accepted client BulkParams; the failure key is issue_id.
R2-D3: params are validated once before any issue changes; archive goes through validate_archive_request with no default kind; until_escalating takes neither duration nor count.
R2-D4: all-matching Mark remediated sends bulk request_verification {verification: {action: remove, include_linked: false}} (INT-W2-05); merge and start workflow stay finite-selection only.
R2-D5..R2-D8: p06 owns the carry-over end to end; inventory tests read-only; p11 owns the v12 RBAC inventory; same-wave dependsOn rule (not needed at 9accc07).
D11-D13, D18-D21, D25-D27, D30 and sections 8, 9, 11, 12 of the design are unchanged from session 11.
supportedEdgeCases: p06: period=custom without start/end -> 422 and no change; until_escalating with duration -> 422; archive without kind -> 422; 1002 matching -> processed 1000 and truncated; merge with a requested exception -> merged_group; merge into an archived primary never escalates and never changes archive_until.

p08: a second match within the action interval writes one suppressed_interval row per window; a rule whose start_workflow is already triggered by the same event -> duplicate_trigger; archived issues and merged children never match frequency or values.
p11: deactivating the last admin -> 409 last_admin; a viewer self token with write -> 422; an ownership pattern or test locator with a sample secret -> 422 with no echo.

p07: First/Latest navigation is chronological (B1); 120 findings counted fully (B7); mention edits notify only new mentions; a manual unsubscribe is never overridden; GitHub create body holds masked fields only and a DLP block sends nothing.
p10: means are null with no data; integrations responses hold no token, host, email or secret ref.
p14/p15/p16: accessible names 'More', 'History', 'Edit Alex Morgan' and 'Getting started' exist so the screenshot states do not skip.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Router registration, wiring and route-walk inclusion of the new routers: v13-p12, run 3.
Full v13 leak matrix, E2E flows E1-E5, strict screenshots and live checks: v13-p17, run 3.
Deferred product areas: releases, environments, projects, Discover, Jira create, replay, performance and profiling.
